systems.owner: Ministry of Transport, Posts and Telecommunications, through the General Directorate of Telecommunications and New Technologies
systems.tiers: described by the World Bank as the main national plan for the digital transformation of the economy and a common plan with indicators, projects, lines of action and execution plans (no cost stated); four objectives: universal access, digitised administrative procedures, ICT sector, citizen digital skills. Classed sector-ict because it is the ministry's own plan and no whole-government adoption is stated; the parent may reclassify to national on the World Bank's wording
announced January 2021; technology and innovation a cross-cutting theme with a specific ICT chapter

systems.country_label: National Plan for Economic and Social Development (Horizonte 2020)
systems.tiers: phases 2008-2012 and 2013-2017; mid-term evaluation acknowledged shortcomings in public administration modernisation
drafting; launch workshop held in November 2022 under the UNDP project Support to the Digitalization of Equatorial Guinea

note: The diagnostic states Equatorial Guinea is without a national e-governance strategy for digital public platforms and that CNIAPGE lacks a digital strategy with clear metrics; ADIGE is not classed national here, so no fact is recorded.
